utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I heard the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center — just making sure you got the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Wait, Sunday? I've been prepping everything for Saturday. Oren was just asking about bringing his toaster in for fixing. Are you sure it changed?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm certain — I heard it straight from Rosa, and I even saw the crew setting up near the old oak tree this morning to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thanks Dane! I hadn't heard about the move to Sunday. I'll make a note to update the location in my log.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal, I heard you're working on that old GPS—think you might take a look at my radio, too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, Uli, I can take a look at your radio. Just bring it by when you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds like you're in, Nell. Just show up at the community center Saturday morning, they'll set you up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Mina! I'll be there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bring your own paintbrush; they might not have enough to go around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, see you there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Saturday at 10. I'll be there... hopefully with a wrench.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, a wrench will do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard much about it. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's this weekend at the community center—they're taking old electronics to fix up for folks who can't afford repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's a great idea—I've got an old toaster and a lamp that might be worth bringing by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that. Works better if you tighten the screws, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, you got it. A good tight screw makes all the difference. I've got my toolbox ready if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's good you're prepared. I might have a thing or two that needs a screw tightened—when's this all going down?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday from 10 to 4? Great, I'll bring my toaster then. Thanks for the info!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad you're bringing something. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I'll make sure to remember to bring it... wait, what was I saying?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let me pull together a list of the most needed items—I'll check with Jules about the tools too!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, just let me know when you have it and I'll start rounding up the parents.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll have that list ready for you by tomorrow morning, Faye. I'll also reach out to Jules tonight about the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Tess mentioned the repair drive too—I just hope we have enough people to sort through all the donations. Do you know if they've set a time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We're still finalizing the exact time, but it's now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday? Oh dear, I was already planning around Saturday, but at least we have that extra day to coordinate the parking situation.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! Are you planning to come to the repair drive? I've got some old tools I'm excited to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, a repair drive! That sounds great—count me in. Let me know what tools you need help bringing or fixing up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Sam! I was thinking we could set up a little station to sort through donations—want to help me organize that?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll need to know the exact time and what tools are needed before I commit. Can we set a clear schedule?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you really sure there's a repair drive? I still haven't seen any proof of it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Kira, I prefer to stick to what's been confirmed. Until we have a set date and a list of tools, I'm not committing either.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, I've been spreading the word myself—maybe we should double-check with the organizers before we get everyone's hopes up!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's a good idea, Quinn. Do you know who's actually running it? I haven't seen anyone I recognize yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You know, I thought it was that nice couple from two streets over, but now I'm second-guessing—maybe I should track down the real source.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, were you at the old oak tree earlier? Did you see who was running the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I wasn't at the old oak tree earlier, but I've been asking around about that repair drive. Are you involved in it, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not directly involved yet—I'm just trying to piece together who's behind it before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it's actually on Sunday now, at the community center. Did you hear that too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was Saturday — where'd you hear it was Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive this weekend. I'm not sure I have anything worth fixing, though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive, right. I think it's... this weekend? Honestly, I wouldn't know what to bring either, I've got a toaster that's been acting weird for months.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I've got an old radio that's been sitting in the closet for years. Maybe it's time to see if it can be saved.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect! I'll be there on Saturday. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! The repair drive. Great, Saturday it is! I'll, uh, try to remember to bring my broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You know, I've got a box of spare screws and wires if your toaster needs any—just ask me on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, you’ve got to hear about the repair drive—I’ve been spreading the word to everyone! Got anything broken you’ve been meaning to fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, absolutely! I've got some old tools I'm planning to bring—Mara mentioned you might have spare parts, so we'll make a great team!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect! I've got a bunch of spare parts for tools, so we'll definitely get those fixed up. Let's rally more people!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? They're taking old electronics to fix up for folks who can't afford repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh yeah, I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center. Good thing you mentioned it, I was about to show up on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, moved to Sunday? I thought it was Saturday—did someone tell you that for sure?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just making sure you know where the overflow lot is—it's behind the old bakery, easy to miss.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, behind the bakery. I'll use that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, good. And don't forget the main lot will be a zoo, so that overflow spot is a lifesaver.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think I heard something about it being moved to Sunday at the community center, but I'm not entirely sure where that came from.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I didn't know about the change. Rosa asked me to help but didn't mention a new day.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That makes sense—Dane told me Rosa mentioned Sunday at the community center. I trust Dane, so I'm leaning toward that being correct.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, have you heard anything about the repair drive? I'm trying to figure out if it's really this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, definitely! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4 — they'll have folks who can fix just about anything, and I'm bringing my toaster. Do you have anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, so it's set for Saturday then! I've got a lamp that's been flickering for weeks — guess I'll bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! Just a heads up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, Sunday works better for me anyway, Rosa. I was worried it'd clash with my Saturday morning walk.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great to hear, Eli! We'll have more space at the community center too, so bring your old electronics.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard much about it. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure there's a repair drive? I haven't heard anything about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I thought I heard something about tools being collected, but maybe I mixed it up with something else.
